# LangGraph App — Full Technical Documentation

> Complete architecture, API specification, database schemas, Knowledge Base engine, Agent Evaluation Studio, and deployment guide.

---

## 1. System Architecture

LangGraph App is a full-stack Next.js 16 (App Router) application integrating LangGraph for agent orchestration and Better Auth for authentication.

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (Turbopack), React, TailwindCSS v4, `@assistant-ui/react`, Radix UI, Lucide icons. The marketing landing page at `/` is server-rendered with one `landing-motion-provider` client island so first paint never blocks on the motion bundle.
- **Backend / Agent Engine**: `@langchain/langgraph`, `@langchain/openai`, custom tool registry, dual-graph architecture (Foreground streaming graph `agent` + Background async subgraphs `backgroundAgent` + standalone `kbAgent` for ingestion + standalone `evalAgent` for LLM-as-a-Judge + benchmark orchestration).
- **Database & Storage**: PostgreSQL 16 with `pgvector` extension for vector embeddings, Drizzle ORM, Cloudflare R2 for object storage.
- **Observability**: Custom `BaseCallbackHandler` span collector, trace waterfall UI, and memory profile inspectability.
- **Eval & A/B**: `lib/eval/` module owns the prompt versioning / A-B traffic splitting / per-agent rubrics / benchmark datasets / AI-Judge orchestration. Wired across both graphs via a process-singleton `EvalCallbackHandler` that mirrors the same `creditTrackingHandler` callback-fan-out pattern.

---

## 2. API Specification

All `/api/*` routes are wrapped with `withAuth` (from `lib/auth/with-auth.ts`) and execute on `runtime = "nodejs"`. The catch-all `/api/[..._path]` proxies LangGraph calls from Next.js to the LangGraph dev server with per-turn credit enforcement.

### Authentication & User Management
- `POST /api/auth/[...all]`: Better Auth endpoints (email/password, OAuth, session management).
- `GET /api/admin/users`: List all users with role snapshots, avatar images, and token/credit usage.
- `PATCH /api/admin/users/[id]`: Update user role or toggle ban status (revokes active sessions immediately).
- `DELETE /api/admin/users/[id]`: Delete user and cascade threads, checkpoints, memory profiles, and attachments.

### Threads & Assistant Streaming
- `GET /api/threads`: List threads for current authenticated user (filtered by `kind='chat'`).
- `POST /api/threads`: Create a new thread.
- `GET /api/threads/[id]`: Fetch thread message history.
- `DELETE /api/threads/[id]`: Delete thread and associated checkpointer state.
- `POST /api/threads/[id]/observability/[parentMessageId]`: Per-turn span waterfall.
- `POST /api/threads/[id]/stream`: Stream assistant response via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

### Memory
- `GET /api/memory/profile`: Profile doc + read-only better-auth fields + flat thread summaries.
- `DELETE /api/memory/profile/[key]`: Remove a single profile key.
- `DELETE /api/memory/threads`: Bulk-delete thread summaries.
- `DELETE /api/memory/threads/[threadId]`: Remove a single thread's summary.

### Knowledge Base (KB v3)
- `GET /api/kb/folders`: List Knowledge Base folders and documents.
- `POST /api/kb/folders`: Create a new Knowledge Base folder.
- `DELETE /api/kb/folders/[id]`: Delete folder and cascade inner documents, vector chunks, and entity graph triples.
- `POST /api/kb/documents`: Upload document to Knowledge Base folder.
- `POST /api/kb/search`: Perform Hybrid (Vector + Keyword) & GraphRAG (Entity-Relationship) search.
- `POST /api/kb/upload`: Direct upload path for KB ingestion (R2-backed attachments).
- `POST /api/kb/documents/[id]/reprocess`: Re-run KB pipeline for a document.

### Agent Evaluation & A/B Testing (`/api/eval/*`)
- `POST /api/eval/feedback`: Submit user / admin rating (1-5). The chat UI sends the assistant message id (`resp_...`); the route resolves it via `eval_run.id` OR `eval_run.parent_message_id` and silently no-ops when no match — the thumbs-up button never crashes on a dangling FK.
- `GET / POST / PUT / DELETE /api/eval/prompts`: Prompt template + variant CRUD with admin actions `create_template` / `create_cohort_variant` / `delete_cohort_variant` / `create_variant` / `update_variant_weight` / `batch_update_weights`.
- `GET / POST /api/eval/rubrics`: List every rubric + recent judgments joined to `eval_run.agent`; upsert by `id` (default `rubric_${Date.now()}`).
- `GET / POST /api/eval/benchmarks`: Per-agent benchmark CRUD; `update_rubric` action mutates the rubric in place.
- `POST /api/eval/benchmarks/run`: Trigger a stored benchmark end-to-end via `evalAgent` in `mode="benchmark"`; thread `kind="eval-benchmark"` (hidden from Online Executions).
- `POST /api/eval/judge`: Trigger LLM-as-a-Judge against an existing `eval_run` via `evalAgent` in `mode="judge"`; thread `kind="eval-judge"` (surfaces in Online Executions).
- `GET /api/eval/runs/compare`: Aggregated A/B metrics + first page of recent run logs per agent. Excludes `kind='eval-benchmark'`.
- `GET /api/eval/runs/page?agent=<id>&cursor=<runId>&limit=<n>`: Per-agent paginated Online Executions (cursor-based, microsecond-stable via PG row-value comparison on `(created_at, id)`). Excludes `kind='eval-benchmark'`.
- `GET /api/eval/runs/[id]`: Single-run drilldown (run + feedback + judgment + first 20 spans).
- `GET / POST /api/eval/assignments`: Sticky `(userId, agent)` prompt-variant bindings. POST supports both cohort-level (`cohortLabel`) and single-agent (`targetVariantId`) reassignment.

### Credit & Quotas
- `GET /api/credit/status`: Fetch current user's credit usage, window limit, and reset timestamp.
- `GET /api/credit/history`: Paginated LLM invocation log with token counts and calculated credits.

---

## 3. Knowledge Base & Search Engine

The Knowledge Base uses a multi-stage retrieval architecture with seven source kinds (PDF, image, plain text, markdown, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, plus pasted URLs fetched via Jina Reader):

1. **Hybrid Dense/Sparse Search**:
   - Dense vector similarity via `pgvector` (`cosine` distance over 1536d / 1024d embeddings).
   - Sparse keyword matching over full-text tsvector indexes.
2. **GraphRAG Entity Expansion**:
   - Automatic entity & relationship extraction during document processing (`chunkExtract` agent node).
   - Graph leg traversal connecting related entities to retrieve multi-hop context (`chunkAlignment` agent node resolves entity aliases before retrieval).
3. **Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)**:
   - Combines vector, keyword, and entity graph rankings into a unified relevance score.
   - `meta.langgraph_node` values for KB sub-agents are `pageToMarkdown`, `chunkExtract`, `chunkAlignment` — these are the same ids the Agent Evaluation Studio uses for Online Executions.

---

## 4. Agent Evaluation & A/B Platform

The Evaluation Studio (`/admin/eval`) ships with the repo, not as a bolt-on. Eight tables:

| Table | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `prompt_template` | System prompt definitions and revision history |
| `prompt_variant` | A/B variants with `traffic_weight` (0-100) |
| `prompt_variant_assignment` | Sticky `(user_id, agent)` binding |
| `eval_run` | Turn execution record with latency / tokens / `parent_message_id` (JOINs `observability_spans`) |
| `eval_feedback` | Online 1-5 rating (👍=5, 👎=1) |
| `eval_rubric` | Per-agent criteria (keyed by `id = "rubric_${agentId}"`); plus `rubric_default` as generic fallback |
| `eval_benchmark` | Admin-defined offline benchmark test cases per agent with denormalized `latest_judgment_id` / `latest_score` for inline "Last Result" |
| `eval_judgment` | Per-run assessment scores + reasoning emitted by `evalAgent` |

### Thread `kind` enum discriminator
- `chat` — user chat turns (sidebar visible)
- `kb` — standalone `kbAgent` ingestion runs
- `eval-judge` — LLM-as-a-Judge scoring runs (surfaces in Online Executions)
- `eval-benchmark` — synthetic benchmark runs (hidden from Online Executions; Benchmark Datasets surface only)

### Seeded agent IDs (11)
`chatAgent`, `routerAgent`, `weatherAgent`, `cryptoAgent`, `codeAgent`, `pageToMarkdown`, `chunkExtract`, `chunkAlignment`, `renameThreadAgent`, `threadSummarizeAgent`, `judgeByLLM`. `seedInitialPrompts` (idempotent, runs on every migration) populates:
- one `prompt_template` + one `prompt_variant` per agent,
- one `eval_rubric` per agent (incl. `judgeByLLM`: `criteria_alignment` 0.4 / `reasoning_clarity` 0.4 / `calibration` 0.2),
- one or more `eval_benchmark` rows per agent,
- a generic `rubric_default` (relevance 0.5 / accuracy 0.5) as the judge fallback.

### `evalAgent` graph
A separate StateGraph (`backend/agent/eval-agent.ts:graph`, registered as `evalAgent` in `langgraph.json`). Two modes dispatched via `mode` input + `routeFromInput` conditional edges:
- `mode="judge"` (default): scores an existing `eval_run` against its rubric → writes `eval_judgment`.
- `mode="benchmark"`: invokes the target agent with the benchmark's `inputPrompt`, writes `eval_run` + paired observability span, then judges against `rubric_${targetAgent}` (or `rubricId` override), denormalizes `latest_judgment_id` / `latest_score` onto `eval_benchmark`.

The `EvalCallbackHandler` (`backend/eval/callback.ts`, singleton in `backend/callbacks.ts`) fires on every chat-model `handleChatModelStart` / `handleLLMEnd` and writes a row to `eval_run` keyed by `parent_message_id`. It reads the user id from the run's top-level `metadata.user_id` (NOT from `configurable.userId` — LangGraph surfaces top-level metadata on every callback).

---

## 5. Credit & Quota System

- **Calculation**: Credits are computed per LLM call using model-specific input/output pricing (`inputPer1k`, `outputPer1k`).
- **Enforcement**: Checked before LLM invocation (`checkCredit`). If window usage exceeds role limit, `CreditExceededError` halts execution gracefully and the proxy synthesizes a `show_credit_card` SSE stream.
- **Admin Quotas**: Roles can have custom `creditLimit` (integers) and `windowHours` (e.g. 24h rolling window). Admin role carries `creditLimit = null` (unlimited).

---

## 6. Deployment Guide

### Prerequisites
- Node.js >= 22.x
- PostgreSQL 16+ with `pgvector` extension enabled
- Cloudflare R2 bucket for file attachments
- Docker Engine 24+ with the Compose plugin

### Environment Variables
```env
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://langgraph:secret@postgres:5432/langgraph_app
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
BETTER_AUTH_URL=https://chat.example.com
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
OPENAI_BASE_URL=                          # leave empty for stock OpenAI
OPENAI_MODEL=                             # leave empty for provider default
JINA_API_KEYS=jina_abc,jina_def            # comma-separated; rotates + blacklists on 401/403
LANGGRAPH_API_URL=http://localhost:2024
LANGGRAPH_ASSISTANT_ID=agent               # or backgroundAgent / kbAgent / evalAgent
LLM_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)   # AES-256-GCM KEK for provider.apiKeys
INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL=you@example.com        # first matching signup is promoted to admin
WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID=your_project_id  # non-secret; surfaces via window.__CONFIG__
R2_ACCOUNT_ID=...                         # server-only
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...                      # server-only
R2_BUCKET=langgraph-app
R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://file.example.com
ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED=true
RESEND_API_KEY=re_...                     # verification emails
```

### Migration & Build Commands
```bash
# Run database migrations (Drizzle + langgraph PostgresStore + PostgresSaver; all idempotent)
pnpm db:migrate

# First-time seed: Eval Studio data + Admin Eval prompts/rubrics/benchmarks
# (runs automatically via seedInitialPrompts on first migrate)

# Build production bundle
pnpm build

# Start production server
docker compose up -d
```

### First-time Postgres fix (langgraph-api 0.10.x)
On first boot of the langgraph-api Python runtime, `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY store_prefix_idx` is wrapped in a transaction and Postgres rejects it. Workaround: see `docs/DEPLOY.md § First-time Postgres fix`. Idempotent.
